title: A Mars Cloud 1,100 Miles Long Forms and Vanishes Every Morning

scenes.text: A cloud on Mars is 1,100 miles long.
It forms before sunrise over a giant volcano called Arsia Mons.
In about two and a half hours, it grows at over 370 miles an hour.
Then it breaks away and evaporates by late morning.
It's made of water ice, and it repeats every morning for months.
A thousand-mile cloud. Gone by lunchtime.

description:
A cloud on Mars stretches 1,100 miles long, then disappears again by late morning.
It forms over the volcano Arsia Mons and repeats every morning for months.
Would you watch a sunrise on Mars?
first_comment: A cloud this long grows and vanishes every day for months. What would you name it?
